objective: Finish the nine-stage manual and convert two declared rules into checks that fail.
completed: Built a cross-page near-duplicate detector, calibrated against the drift that actually shipped: 0.741 for the real defect, 0.579 highest on the corrected tree, threshold 0.70
Added an element-level pass after an agent demonstrated the sentence pass is blind to a lifted table row, because cells strip into one run with no terminal punctuation
Audited all 48 exit-gate items across six pages and DECLINED to adopt the proposed rule, which is dischargeable by adding a table row
Fixed the defects that are real independent of the rule, including the inverse one a gate-to-artifact rule cannot see
Wrote discover.html, define.html and learn.html via three independent agents, none of which wrote the existing six
Trimmed all three from a mean of 2791 words to the house band after measuring every page with one extractor
Removed three cross-page duplicates the element-level pass found in the ORIGINAL six pages
Linked all nine stages from index.html
remaining: Human review and merge of four pull requests
Split the exit-gate rule into four checks including the inverse one
The binding-authority question, which no agent can answer

validation.command: negative control: sentence-level duplicate injected into learn.html
negative control: element-level lifted table row injected into discover.html
negative control: broken cross-page link in discover.html
positive control: all three reverted, full suite re-run

observations: The three FAIL rows are deliberate controls, reverted. The element-level control fired at 1.000 and my first grep did not show it, because the pattern matched 0.NNN and cannot match 1.000 - the filter was blind, not the detector

The detector found a duplicate in discover.html that the writer's own 6-gram shingle check reported clean: an architect.html sentence with a clause spliced into its middle, which breaks every shingle window spanning it but not a sequence ratio

The element-level pass then found two duplicates in the ORIGINAL six pages that the sentence pass had never seen, plus a third in architect.html - so the instrument had been hiding duplication in the pages it was built to police

Word counts: nine stages total 13553; learn 1780 is 83 words over the band top of 1700 and is accepted, because trimming further meant deleting the three defect-escape verdicts that make the page operable

All three writers overshot the length brief by roughly 2x. The brief said 'at least 1200, aim 1300-1500' and the floor dominated in every case - a prompt defect, not three independent judgement errors
decisions: The proposed exit-gate rule is NOT adopted. It grades a well-anchored item and a total orphan identically on the two pages lacking an outputs section, false-positives on legitimate cross-stage references, and is dischargeable by adding a table row
Duplicates found in the existing six are fixed by differentiating what each page means at its own stage and linking the owner, not by allowlisting
learn.html is accepted over the length band rather than cutting load-bearing content to satisfy a number I chose
assumptions: The three new pages have not been independently reviewed; only the detector and the validator have run against them

blockers.resolution: A human reviews and merges. Agents must not merge.

authority.granted: Documentation and test changes via pull request, per operator instruction 2026-09-03
authority.withheld: Architecture acceptance, platform implementation, Pages settings changes, merging
